title: What are you doing this week?
content_html:
Well, today I accidentally deleted an API token used by our staging environment.

Then, I proceeded to destroy accidentally the staging environment.

In both cases we made small improvements to prevent similar issues, but my mind is not in the right place. Went for a walk because I felt I would have nuked production next if I had continued. It's been a stressful period recently.

(Work is boring- I got to split our single node deployments into multi node for security purposes. But really we have nearly 0 users and 0 product yet, so it's not very motivating right now, because it's tedious and I have to preserve data and reduce downtime. At least I'm learning some Nix stuff.)

(But actually, the staging environment nuking was brought to you by lack of hosting providers that provide NixOS support. nixos-anywhere is pretty cool, but also a loaded gun if you are not paying attention.)

好吧，今天我不小心删除了我们的暂存环境使用的 API 令牌。

然后，我意外地破坏了暂存环境。

在这两种情况下，我们都做了一些小的改进来防止类似的问题，但我的想法不正确。 去散步是因为我觉得如果我继续的话，接下来我就会用核武器摧毁生产。 最近一段时间压力很大。

（工作很无聊 - 出于安全目的，我必须将单节点部署拆分为多节点。 但实际上我们还拥有近 0 个用户和 0 个产品，所以现在没有太大动力，因为这很乏味，我必须保留数据并减少停机时间。 至少我正在学习一些 Nix 的东西。）

（但实际上，由于缺乏提供 NixOS 支持的托管提供商，给您带来了临时环境核武器。 nixos-anywhere 非常酷，但如果你不注意的话，它也是一把上膛的枪。）
